data.one_liner: Create guided tours for app widgets
data.what_it_does: Features Tour lets you define ordered steps that highlight widgets and show descriptive overlays. It provides callbacks for before/after each step and supports custom styling.
use_when: introducing new features in an app
avoid_when: apps that require complex nested navigation or deep linking that cannot be captured by a single controller
strengths: Simple API with controller and widget pair
Customizable appearance via global and per‑step configs
Handles drawers, dialogs and scrolling widgets
weaknesses: Only works on Flutter, no native platform integration
Limited to widget‑based tours, not full screen flows
